# @tanstack/charts (vendored)

Pinned **0.9.0** runtime ESM from the package `dist/` (`.js` only; no
framework adapters, no `.d.ts`).

Import with **relative** paths from app modules, e.g.
`../vendor/tanstack-charts/dom.js`. Prefer narrow entries over `index.js`.

See `app/components/charts.js` for version constants and refresh notes.
